title: V3 stage-oriented refactor P11 minimal compatibility bridge
goal: Enable the current trusted base to verify the aggregate P11 publication and its public facade without exempting any protected deletion, trusted-component change or policy weakening.
acceptanceCriteria: Multiple changed formal plans are accepted only when exactly one changed *-aggregate.plan.json covers the real pull request diff; zero or multiple aggregate plans fail closed.
